title: Locksmith Customer Completion Sign-Off Form
subtitle: Control authority verification, access service, key control, testing, and secure release through verified identity, domain-specific observations, evidence, authorization, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original, workflow-complete locksmith service customer completion sign-off for openings, locks, keys, credentials, closers, and access devices. It connects verified access authority and approved security scope to present conditions, repeatable evidence, decisions, unresolved work, and the receiving party's handoff.
use_case: Use when a qualified locksmith and authorized property or access representative must reconcile the promised locksmith service scope, actual work, evidence, limitations, remaining actions, and custody transfer.

sections.title: Locksmith limitations, unresolved concerns, and callback plan
sections.guidance: Acceptance must not conceal a defect, incomplete task, service restriction, or promised follow-up.

blocks.label: Unresolved condition or follow-up trigger
items: Identity, occupancy, ownership, management, agency, or access authority disputed
Requested opening, vehicle, safe, key, or credential exceeds approved scope
Fire-rated, egress, panic, emergency-access, or shared-opening function uncertain
Master-key hierarchy, restricted keyway, or credential population may be affected
Alarm, access-control, intercom, power, or life-safety integration unavailable
Door, frame, glass, hinge, closer, structure, or finish may be damaged
Key, blank, core, credential, code, or removed-hardware custody discrepancy
Opening cannot be secured during or after work
Evidence of forced entry, tampering, crime, or safety concern requires escalation
Customer requests reusable security secrets in unrestricted notes or communications

sections.title: Locksmith customer completion sign-off closeout and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when outcome, remaining limitation, next action, evidence, and receiving ownership agree.

blocks.label: Final outcome, handoff, and record location
Record boundary and stop condition
blocks.guidance: This locksmith service customer completion sign-off is an operational record, not a substitute for applicable law, licensing, product labeling, manufacturer instructions, site policy, safety requirements, or professional judgment. Stop affected work, access, application, operation, testing, or release when identity, access authority, property scope, key control, alarm integration, fire egress, security function, or credential custody is uncertain. A locksmith, security, or egress supervisor must review the exception, authorize the controlling decision, and preserve its evidence before closeout.

blocks.guidance: A signature records accountability for the stated outcome; it does not cure missing evidence or override a stop condition.
